Bulk remove-tag is in. Refresh **http://maker:4001/?many=300** and try it:

Select several links, then click **"－ Remove tag."** It shows which tags currently exist across your selection, and removing one strips it from all selected links at once (links that didn't have that tag are simply unaffected). Combined with **"＋ Add tag,"** you can now retag a big collection in both directions.

Does that complete the bulk-tagging you need for reorganizing?

If so, that wraps up the **large-collection** boundary. Next I'll move to **error and unusual-input situations** — saving an address that can't be reached, and typing something that isn't a web address at all — to make sure the app stays trustworthy when inputs are messy.
